title: Concord Community Extension Repository Index (concord-repo/v1)
description: Machine-checkable schema for the static-hostable repository index served at B/.well-known/concord-repo.json (or B/index.json). A single base URL B is the entire contract. URLs may be repo-relative for portability. Authoritative permission data lives in each bundle's manifest.json; the index permissions array is display-only and advisory.

schema.description: REQUIRED literal repository-protocol version. A client encountering an unknown major version MUST refuse the repo.

repo_id.description: Stable repository slug. Reverse-domain or kebab-case identifier.

icon.description: Repo icon URL (absolute or repo-relative to B).

updated_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the last index build.

signing.description: Optional Tier-2 signing block (Ed25519 detached signature over the canonical index bytes with index_sig blanked and keys sorted). Drives the verified/unverified trust badge only; never gates install.

index_sig.description: Base64 detached signature over the canonical index.

extensions.description: All extensions published by this repo.

id.description: Reverse-domain extension id; MUST match the bundle manifest.id.

icon.description: Icon name (e.g. a Material symbol) or URL.

latest.description: SemVer of the default-install version. MUST appear in versions[].version.

bundle_url.description: URL of the bundle .zip (absolute or repo-relative to B). Fed verbatim to POST /api/extensions/install as remote_url.

integrity.description: Tier-1 (MANDATORY) SHA-384 Subresource-Integrity string for bundle.zip. Server recomputes post-fetch, pre-unpack, and rejects on mismatch.

min_concord_version.description: Minimum running Concord version this bundle supports (SemVer).

manifest_url.description: URL of the bundle's manifest.json (absolute or repo-relative).

permissions.description: Display-only advisory permission list. The bundle's manifest.json is authoritative; clients MUST warn on mismatch.

semver.description: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 string (optionally with pre-release / build metadata).
